An exotic skill is bought once for each specific weapon or vehicle, and has no specializations. Name the item and give it points to add it; set an added skill's points to 0 to remove it.
"Karma pts" (Step Seven) raises a group's rating beyond its priority points, at new Rating × 5 Karma per point.

A skill's own points are ignored whenever its group has points spent (the group rating wins) — see the "strict skill groups" rule. A specialization costs 1 extra skill point (on top of whatever bought the rating) and only applies to a skill bought individually here — not one whose rating comes from a purchased skill group.

"Karma pts"/"Karma spec" (Step Seven) can raise or specialize a skill beyond what the columns above allow, at new Rating × 2 Karma per point / 7 Karma flat per specialization — including a skill whose rating comes from a purchased group, which permanently breaks that group from this point forward (its other members keep their current rating, but can no longer be raised together as a group).
